'''Deinotherium''' is an [[extinct]] relative of [[elephant]]s, introduced in the [[Release_information/53.15|Dino Update]] along with other [[Creature#Extinct|prehistoric creatures]]. Deinotheriums are over twice the weight of actual elephants, but otherwise share many characteristics with them, such as the same lifespan, [[grazer|grazing]], and being trainable for war.

Deinotherium products are luxuriously [[valuable]], being priced ten times as much as common materials and twice than those from regular elephants.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] deinotheriums for their ''backward-curving tusks''.
